shortDescription: Manage entries in the Elasticsearch keystore

options.name: create_keystore
options.description: Whether to create the keystore if one doesn't already exist.

options.name: force
options.description: When used with state=present, existing entries with the same name will be replaced.

options.name: name
options.description: Keystore value to add or remove.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the entry should exist or not, taking action if the state is different from what is stated.

options.name: value
options.description: Data to be stored inside the entry. Required if state=present.
